rejected.s: Look, there is no one at the door!
rejected.reason: checker: An empty doorway can feel a little spooky, and 'no one' is not the yes/no sense.

rejected.s: We have no school on Saturday!
rejected.reason: checker: 'We have play school on Saturday' also makes sense. (also fits: play)
